---
title: "running_track"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

running <- read.csv("NCAA_track.csv")

running <- running |> separate(Year, into = c("Class", "Year"), sep = "-")

running <- running |> mutate(Time = ms(Time))

running <- running |> mutate(Time = as.duration(Time))
```

```{r}
speed <- running |> mutate(Time = as.double(Time))

speed <- speed |> mutate(Speed = Event/Time)

speed <- speed |> mutate(EventName = as.factor(Event))

ggplot(speed, aes(x = Event, y = Speed)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)
```
